about: Step 3B PR 8b answer key (tests/delivery/expected/records.json), written by the controller by hand before the code under rulings R3, R24 condition 2 and 8b-1 to 8b-12 (pr8b-rulings.md). Each row inserts `insert` into the fixture immediately before its `anchor` (which occurs exactly once), parses the result and builds the module's record blocks. `expected`: the blocks in order, cells as the slice's Cell (null, {kind: gap, reason}, {kind: value, text, at}) or a plain string; `at` is a decimal string compared as Decimal(at) == the built Decimal, or null. `refused`: the builder raises DeliveryRefused (R24 condition 1). Every name is invented; the fixture says SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Implementers do not edit this file.
